data.title: Where you'll meet [[Claude]]
data.subtitle: Three apps, three ways of working and three extras. One account.

cards.title: claude.ai
cards.text: Claude in any web browser. Nothing to install.

cards.title: Claude Desktop
cards.text: Mac, Windows and Linux (beta), from claude.com/download.

cards.title: Phone apps
cards.text: iPhone, iPad and Android: search 'Claude by Anthropic'.

cards.title: Chat
cards.text: You ask, Claude answers, you go back and forth.

cards.title: Cowork
cards.text: Hand over a task, get finished files back. Runs in the cloud.
cards.quote: Build a report from these files.

cards.title: Claude Code
cards.text: Reads code, edits files and runs commands. For developers.
cards.quote: Skip it if you don't code.

cards.title: Claude in Chrome
cards.text: A browser extension: Claude reads, clicks and moves around websites.
cards.quote: It waits for you on purchases.

cards.title: Microsoft 365
cards.text: Claude inside Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook.

cards.title: Voice mode
cards.text: Talk instead of typing. Built to work best on a phone.
